Amid election fraud, violence, and arrests targeting his party and its supporters, opposition candidate Morgan Tsvangirai states that he is dropping out of the race, effectively handing the presidency back to Mugabe.
Mugabe is sworn in for his sixth term as Zimbabwe's president.
Mugabe signs a power-sharing deal with political rival Morgan Tsvangirai in order to end months of unrest.
Mugabe will remain president and Tsvangirai will assume post of prime minister and coordinator of government affairs.
